name: qUSm3_statprior_var
title: Stationary Exchangeable VAR(p): Heaps Three-Variable Prior
description: A stationary VAR using the exchangeable partial-autocorrelation prior from Section 3.2 of Heaps (2023), with fixed m = 3 application hyperparameters from supplement S6.2: e = 0, f = sqrt(0.455), g = 1.365, h = 0.071; Sigma ~ IW(m + 4, I).
